npc-greeting-text: Hey Mr. Chanko, how have you been?
npc-quest-completion-message: Oh god, it is a catttt

npc-quest-information: You will have to fix a cocktail drink for everyone. I will give you the recipes in real life. Once all have drank from their cocktail, I will be in awe.
I carry items from a distant land. You need to throw all four to the four different sides in one go. It is proof that you are lucky, and I follow luck.
I enjoy good humor. Think of a joke that will make at least 13 people laugh or a riddle that no more than 3 people can guess.
npc-quest-completion-message: I didn't think you could pull it off! Seshtings??

npc-quest-information: I have been hit in the head and don't remember much. I know that my stash of items is quite extensive and that I love the smell of fire. However, a lunatic is chasing me and I don't know how to sate his hunger. It seems he is fond of magical items, maybe you can help?
npc-quest-completion-message: Thank you so much, this is the best.

npc-quest-information: I travel a lot. But oftentimes I am hungry. Especially in the morning. Nothing beats a good breakfast to start my day. Everywhere I go, I enjoy tasting the local cuisine. I have not had Bulgarian food before, but I have heard it is the best. My only wish is to have a tasty pastry dish Sunday morning.
npc-quest-completion-message: You have some serious skill! Bulgarian food is my new favorite.

npc-quest-information: roll the perfect joint. Lets smoke it together.
I love music and dancing, apart from hunting and fishing. Make three different people dance with you to three songs of my choice of three different nations. If you do so, I will follow you for life.
npc-quest-completion-message: Song is life, and I am alive.

npc-greeting-text: I will give you a gold coin for every funny joke you say.
npc-quest-information: I want to hear your best poetry piece. It needs to be one of your mighty adventures during the 7 trials and I must like it!
npc-quest-completion-message: Splendid! You are amazing, I will be your student.

npc-quest-information: Izmisli pesen sus AI, koqto da vklychva slednite neshta, koito shte my hrymant v sledvashite 30 sekyndi.
npc-quest-completion-message: Tova parche trqbva da go pysnete na svatbata

npc-greeting-text: Chanko brat, tejak e jivota, no krasiv.
npc-quest-information: Iskam da se tatyiram, no ne znam kato kakvo. Moje li da mi narisyvash ideq?
Imam mishena i nojove za xvurlqne. Ela do nai-blizkoto durvo, i mi pokaji kak se celi bullseye..
Haide da izigraem edna igra na belot.
Iskam da pysha tiytiyn s teb.
